article.title: 騰訊雲公布私有部署方案，企業可分層接入AI代理
article.title_en: Tencent Cloud announces modular private deployment for enterprise AI agents
article.summary: 騰訊雲在深圳公布全棧智能套件和輕量部署方案，讓企業按需要選擇部署層級。
article.summary_en: Tencent Cloud announced a full-stack suite and a lighter deployment option in Shenzhen, with selectable deployment layers.
highlights: 套件涵蓋基礎設施、模型服務、代理運行環境及應用。
公司稱輕量方案可按完整私有雲或只用AI服務配置。
highlights_en: The suite covers infrastructure, model services, agent runtime and applications.
The lighter option has distinct configurations for full cloud and AI-only use.
article.why: 要讓代理讀取企業資料的行銷團隊，可與技術部門分開討論模型、資料及執行權限。
article.why_en: Marketing and IT teams can evaluate models, data access and execution rights separately.
article.next_step: 先列出一項客戶資料使用情境，請技術團隊核對所需部署、權限及日誌。
article.next_step_en: Choose one customer-data scenario and ask IT to verify deployment, permissions and logs.
article.detail: 騰訊雲把模型服務與代理運行環境分開列明。公告描述的運行環境包括隔離程式活動的沙箱、對外連線控制與身分憑證。完整私有雲和只部署AI服務有不同的起步配置，團隊應按現有系統與資料流向評估。選擇私有部署後，仍要逐項驗證代理能讀取哪些資料、呼叫哪些系統，以及誰可查看操作紀錄。
article.detail_en: Tencent Cloud separates model services from the runtime. The runtime includes an isolated sandbox, outbound connection controls and identity credentials. Full private cloud and AI-only setups have different starting configurations. Verify data access, callable systems and audit-log visibility for the intended workflow.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
